intro: The gear behind your favourite creators’ videos, from clip-on mics to 360 cameras, plus the retro cameras Gen Z can’t get enough of.

cardText: Clip-on mics, gimbal and 360 cameras, instant and retro cameras for creators.

blocks.title: Cameras & creator kit
blocks.intro: Filter by age, price or where it’s trending.

sections.html:
1. Sound: a clip-on wireless mic is the biggest upgrade for talking-to-camera videos.
  2. Stability: a tripod or gimbal makes footage instantly look more professional.
  3. Light: face a window, or add a small LED light.
  4. Camera: only then think about a dedicated camera; modern phones are very capable.
